title: Hawk's Peak in Tahoe Donner | KEY.co
description_expanded: Downstairs, guests will find an additional king bedroom and a spacious bunk room designed with families in mind—offering sleeping space for six, entertainment, and desk areas for remote learning or creative play. Outside, a private hot tub, lighted Steamscape, and serene pond offer moments of quiet indulgence. Ideally located within walking distance to Tahoe Donner Downhill Ski Area and minutes from Donner Lake, Hawk’s Peak also provides access to exclusive Tahoe Donner amenities including pools, golf, private beach access, and fine dining. Whether you seek peaceful retreat or mountain adventure, this home delivers a curated Tahoe experience in every season. Perched in the heart of Tahoe Donner, Hawk's Peak offers a refined mountain escape with striking design and elevated comfort. This split-level retreat features an open-concept upper floor where a chef-inspired kitchen with a La Cornue gas range flows effortlessly into a warm, light-filled great room. Vaulted ceilings, a gas fireplace, and plush seating invite connection and relaxation, while the expansive Trex deck and stone patio below set the stage for al fresco dining and tranquil evenings under the stars. The primary suite provides a private oasis with a king bed, walk-in closet, and spa-style ensuite bath.
